player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Stimmed Jim''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in August 2000.

starting.card: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die

description: This deck is a machine because everyone prepares for BHBM and Rops but no one knows what to do against Court, went 7-0 in two days at Continentals
cards: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die
notes: Qty 59: the list as posted totals 58; the post says 'None shall pass should be None shall pass x2', so None Shall Pass is listed x2. The update says the Main Course replaced Operational As Planned between day 1 and day 2, but the Main Course is not in the posted list and is not added.

The strategy names All Wrapped Up, No Bargain and Oppressive Enforcement as the three starting Effects (Prepared Defenses is in the list but not named as starting), so starting.interrupt and starting.effect are left empty.
Posted 'grabber x2' is left UNKNOWN (Allegations Of Corruption, the later 'grabber', is a Coruscant card, 2001).

Posted 'Jabba's palace' dested the exterior site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'JP audience chamber' / 'JP dungeon' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber / Dungeon; 'great pit' Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon; 'hoth 5th marker' Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker); 'holotable' Imperial Holotable.

Posted 'dr. e' dested Dr. Evazan; 'Chall' Chall Bekan; 'Bane' Bane Malar; 'Iggy' IG-88; '4lom' 4-LOM; 'jquille' J'Quille; 'brangus' Brangus Glee; 'ehpant mon' Ephant Mon; 'mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'CC engineer' Cloud City Engineer; 'EPP vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber.

Posted 'Scum' dested Scum And Villainy; 'barrier' Imperial Barrier; 'twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'oota goo ta' Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?; 'CHYBC' Come Here You Big Coward; 'projective' Projective Telepathy; 'no bargin' No Bargain; 'oppressive' Oppressive Enforcement. Secret Plans, Battle Order, Come Here You Big Coward and Oppressive Enforcement are the older Effects (not Reflections III shields).
Under 'Ships': 'BIHT' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth, 'zuckuss' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter and 'Fett' Boba Fett In Slave I.
Published title 'Stimmed Jim s Scum' is DeckTech's rendering of 'Stimmed Jim's Scum'; the page title uses the apostrophe, as on his EBO page.
dest_title: 2000 North American Continental Championship Jim Li Stimmed Jim's Scum version 2
player_note: The post says Jim Li made the deck 'just to have some fun for the continental championships' and that 'through out the weekend at gen con, it went 7-0 with wins coming against many top players'. A later update adds 'on how this deck did at worlds, on day 1 it went 3-1, the average (mean) rating of my opponents was 2047', and that between day 1 and day 2 he swapped Operational As Planned for the Main Course and Dengar In Punishing One for Secret Plans, so the list may differ from what was played.
